decks.module: Handbook purpose and required or recommended language

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook prepares people to drive ____.
cards.back: The handbook prepares people to drive passenger vehicles safely.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: If the handbook conflicts with legislation, ____.
cards.back: If the handbook conflicts with legislation, the legislation controls.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: In the handbook, must identifies a legally required ____.
cards.back: In the handbook, must identifies a legally required action or practice.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: In the handbook, should identifies a recommendation that the ____.
cards.back: In the handbook, should identifies a recommendation that the law does not require.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A person with a disability who needs a special examination accommodation should ____.
cards.back: A person with a disability who needs a special examination accommodation should arrange a DMV appointment before visiting.
cards.memory_hook: arrange a DMV appointment before visiting

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An applicant may request an audio examination ____.
cards.back: An applicant may request an audio examination delivered through headphones.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A Blue Certificate is a driver ____.
cards.back: A Blue Certificate is a driver education certificate.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A valid driver education certificate documents successful completion of a course approved by the Delaware Department of Education ____.
cards.back: A valid driver education certificate documents successful completion of a course approved by the Delaware Department of Education and must satisfy that department’s criteria.
cards.memory_hook: and must satisfy that department’s criteria

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An Individualized Education Program serves a person eligible ____.
cards.back: An Individualized Education Program serves a person eligible for specialized education.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A Driving Privilege Card permits driving but cannot ____.
cards.back: A Driving Privilege Card permits driving but cannot serve as valid identification.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A driver license grants its holder the privilege of ____.
cards.back: A driver license grants its holder the privilege of operating a motor vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An identification card may be used as valid ____.
cards.back: An identification card may be used as valid proof of identity.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The National Driver Register records drivers with suspended or revoked licenses and ____.
cards.back: The National Driver Register records drivers with suspended or revoked licenses and drivers convicted of serious traffic offenses.
cards.memory_hook: drivers convicted of serious traffic offenses

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Motor-vehicle agencies consult the National Driver Register to ____.
cards.back: Motor-vehicle agencies consult the National Driver Register to avoid licensing problem drivers.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The SAVE program checks whether USCIS ____.
cards.back: The SAVE program checks whether USCIS documents are authentic.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: For motor-vehicle-law purposes, conviction includes a guilty finding, a guilty plea, ____.
cards.back: For motor-vehicle-law purposes, conviction includes a guilty finding, a guilty plea, or forfeiting a bail bond.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A driver is anyone exercising actual physical control ____.
cards.back: A driver is anyone exercising actual physical control over a motor vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When the handbook uses Department, it means the Department of Transportation acting ____.
cards.back: When the handbook uses Department, it means the Department of Transportation acting itself or through authorized representatives.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: When the handbook uses Division, it means the ____.
cards.back: When the handbook uses Division, it means the Division of Motor Vehicles.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An owner includes the legal titleholder and a buyer paying over time who already ____.
cards.back: An owner includes the legal titleholder and a buyer paying over time who already has the immediate right to possession.
cards.memory_hook: has the immediate right to possession

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: Registration includes both the registration card and the ____.
cards.back: Registration includes both the registration card and the vehicle’s registration plate.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The Secretary is the head of Delaware’s ____.
cards.back: The Secretary is the head of Delaware’s Department of Transportation.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A divided highway separates its roadways with a space, barrier, or marked dividing ____.
cards.back: A divided highway separates its roadways with a space, barrier, or marked dividing area constructed to impede vehicle traffic.
cards.memory_hook: area constructed to impede vehicle traffic

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The highway definition covers the full width within the boundaries of a road open to public vehicle traffic, ____.
cards.back: The highway definition covers the full width within the boundaries of a road open to public vehicle traffic, excluding privately or institutionally owned roads.
cards.memory_hook: excluding privately or institutionally owned roads

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The roadway is the highway portion designed, improved, or ordinarily used for ____.
cards.back: The roadway is the highway portion designed, improved, or ordinarily used for vehicle travel, without its shoulder.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An express highway is a State or Interstate route designed ____.
cards.back: An express highway is a State or Interstate route designed particularly for through traffic.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook uses road with the same ____.
cards.back: The handbook uses road with the same meaning as highway.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A safety zone is an officially marked highway area ____.
cards.back: A safety zone is an officially marked highway area reserved exclusively for pedestrians.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A street is a highway located in a ____.
cards.back: A street is a highway located in a city or suburban district.

decks.module: Intersections, cycling space and turning terms

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A bike box reserves space at the front of an intersection traffic lane so cyclists can turn and ____.
cards.back: A bike box reserves space at the front of an intersection traffic lane so cyclists can turn and position themselves visibly ahead of traffic.
cards.memory_hook: position themselves visibly ahead of traffic

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A highway-rail intersection is the shared area where a highway ____.
cards.back: A highway-rail intersection is the shared area where a highway meets or crosses railroad tracks.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An intersection is the shared area where at least two highways meet, ____.
cards.back: An intersection is the shared area where at least two highways meet, even when neither crosses the other.
cards.memory_hook: even when neither crosses the other

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook uses railroad crossing as another name ____.
cards.back: The handbook uses railroad crossing as another name for a highway-rail intersection.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A three-point turn reverses a vehicle’s direction by one hundred eighty degrees on a narrow street through a left turn, a reverse movement to the ____.
cards.back: A three-point turn reverses a vehicle’s direction by one hundred eighty degrees on a narrow street through a left turn, a reverse movement to the right, and a final right turn.
cards.memory_hook: right, and a final right turn

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A two-way cycle track is physically separated and carries cyclists in both directions ____.
cards.back: A two-way cycle track is physically separated and carries cyclists in both directions along one side of a road.
cards.memory_hook: along one side of a road

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The bicycle definition includes vehicles propelled entirely by a ____.
cards.back: The bicycle definition includes vehicles propelled entirely by a person using foot pedals.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An electric bicycle meets this definition if it has operable pedals, two or three wheels, an electric motor rated below seven hundred fifty watts, and a top speed below twenty miles per hour using only that motor on level pavement ____.
cards.back: An electric bicycle meets this definition if it has operable pedals, two or three wheels, an electric motor rated below seven hundred fifty watts, and a top speed below twenty miles per hour using only that motor on level pavement with a one hundred seventy-pound rider.
cards.memory_hook: with a one hundred seventy-pound rider

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The motor vehicle definition covers self-propelled vehicles designed for roadways while excluding ____.
cards.back: The motor vehicle definition covers self-propelled vehicles designed for roadways while excluding farm tractors and off-highway vehicles.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An off-highway vehicle is a motor-driven vehicle capable of traveling across natural ____.
cards.back: An off-highway vehicle is a motor-driven vehicle capable of traveling across natural terrain without a road or trail.
cards.memory_hook: terrain without a road or trail

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A trailer lacks its own motor and is designed to carry passengers or property ____.
cards.back: A trailer lacks its own motor and is designed to carry passengers or property while another motor vehicle pulls it.
cards.memory_hook: while another motor vehicle pulls it

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The vehicle definition excludes human-powered devices, rail-bound devices, electric trackless trolley coaches, electric personal ____.
cards.back: The vehicle definition excludes human-powered devices, rail-bound devices, electric trackless trolley coaches, electric personal assistive mobility devices, and off-highway vehicles.
cards.memory_hook: assistive mobility devices, and off-highway vehicles

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook defines a school bus as a motor vehicle painted national school-bus chrome yellow ____.
cards.back: The handbook defines a school bus as a motor vehicle painted national school-bus chrome yellow and displaying the words SCHOOL BUS.
cards.memory_hook: and displaying the words SCHOOL BUS

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: The handbook’s general vehicle definition covers devices that can carry or draw people or property on a public ____.
cards.back: The handbook’s general vehicle definition covers devices that can carry or draw people or property on a public highway, subject to its listed exclusions.
cards.memory_hook: highway, subject to its listed exclusions

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: An electric vehicle draws its propulsion from an electric motor and a battery ____.
cards.back: An electric vehicle draws its propulsion from an electric motor and a battery charged by an outside power source.
cards.memory_hook: charged by an outside power source

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A fuel-cell electric vehicle powers its electric motor using ____.
cards.back: A fuel-cell electric vehicle powers its electric motor using a hydrogen fuel cell.

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A non-plug-in hybrid combines a conventional-fuel combustion engine with an electric motor that cannot be ____.
cards.back: A non-plug-in hybrid combines a conventional-fuel combustion engine with an electric motor that cannot be recharged from an outside power source.
cards.memory_hook: recharged from an outside power source

cards.front: Complete the handbook statement: A plug-in hybrid combines a conventional-fuel combustion engine with an electric motor ____.
cards.back: A plug-in hybrid combines a conventional-fuel combustion engine with an electric motor and an externally rechargeable battery.
